compiled_state.title: Wire _scratch_cleanup_for_ticket into ticket-transition.sh on close
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: On `dso ticket transition <id> <status> closed`, per-ticket scratch directory removed (or no-op if absent)

## Description

In plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-transition.sh, after transition event written/committed AND only when target status is `closed`, invoke `_scratch_cleanup_for_ticket <id>`. Invocation MUST be after commit so status change is durable regardless of cleanup outcome. Transition exit code MUST NOT be affected by cleanup helper.

Add RED test cases to tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh:
- Populate scratch dir, run `dso ticket transition <id> <current> closed`, assert dir gone afterwards.
- Non-close transition (e.g., open → in_progress) leaves scratch dir untouched.

## TDD Approach
Given populated scratch dir; When transition to closed; Then dir removed AND event committed. Given non-close transition; Then dir untouched.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format (N/A)
- [ ] transition.sh calls _scratch_cleanup_for_ticket
  Verify: grep -q '_scratch_cleanup_for_ticket' plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-transition.sh
- [ ] Cleanup gated on target=closed
  Verify: grep -B2 '_scratch_cleanup_for_ticket' plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-transition.sh | grep -q closed
- [ ] Close-transition test passes end-to-end
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-transition.sh | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
